blocks.h: Are you in the AI answer?
paras: More buyers start with an AI assistant instead of a search box. An AI visibility audit shows whether those assistants mention you, cite your pages or recommend a competitor instead.

We run a set of real buyer questions for your category across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Gemini. For each one we record brand mentions, cited pages, competitor citations and the sources AI tools trust.

Then we look at why. Missing structured data, weak product feeds, thin answers, poor crawlability and gaps in third-party mentions are the usual causes. Each finding comes with a clear fix and an expected effect on share of voice.
The audit gives you a baseline to track against. Most clients follow it with generative engine optimization work, measured month by month.
